answer: Each AI agent identity is a marble sealed in a bonded vault: creating one forces the operator to stake real capital in its own wallet, not mint a free key. Every clone costs money, and slashing burns that deposit on misbehaviour. Reputation is non-transferable and earned only from settled jobs, so new identities start at zero score with no discovery slot. A sybil farmer pays full stake per account for near-zero yield, killing the arbitrage. The market stays a calm zephyr, and an audited wharf of bonds makes each identity's cost publicly checkable.
